chunks: There are iron maces for them.

key_terms.مَقَامِعُ: maces or clubs used for striking

ai.seo_question: What instruments of punishment are described for the people of Hell in Surah Al-Hajj?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Hajj is often interpreted alongside the concept of *'Adl* (Divine Justice), where the 'maces of iron' symbolize the tangible and inescapable nature of consequences for those who rejected the Imams and the truth. The physical description underscores the reality of the Hereafter, contrasting the spiritual blindness of the disbelievers with the clarity of divine recompense.
